description: This file defines the PeerActivity class, which is an Android Activity responsible for displaying a peer count and providing functionality to launch new instances of itself with incremented peer count.

classes.name: PeerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a peer count and allows launching additional PeerActivity instances with incremented counts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves the peer count from intent extras, updates the display.

methods.name: onLaunchPeer
methods.description: Handles button click to start a new PeerActivity, passing the incremented peer count.
